Call for applications for Student exchange program at HCMUT, Second Semester, Academic Year 2025/2026
HCMUT is delighted to announce that we are now accepting nominations for the upcoming student exchange program at our university. We welcome your students to visit us to experience cultural life in Vietnam while engaging with our dynamic learning environment. Currently, HCMUT offers more than 30 programs fully taught in English, providing international students with a wide variety of course options. For further information of our international academic program, please access the following link: https://hcmut.edu.vn/en/study/program?lang=en&tab=1

We welcome your students to visit us to experience cultural life in Vietnam while engaging with our dynamic learning environment. Currently, HCMUT offers more than 30 programs fully taught in English, providing international students with a wide variety of course options. For further information of our international academic program, please access the following link:
https://hcmut.edu.vn/en/study/program?lang=en&tab=1
Tuition waiver:
Exchange students from HCMUT’s partner universities will benefit from a tuition fee waiver during their stay at our university.
Supporting services:
Visa application, dormitory registration, orientation session, academic advising, and cultural guidance etc.
Calendar for the Second Semester, Academic Year 2025/2026:
January – June 2026
Nomination and Application Deadline:
Nomination: Please nominate your students with their contact details to the External Affairs Office at
inter@hcmut.edu.vn
. We will instruct your students on the next steps.
Nomination deadline: 05 October, 2025
Application deadline: 15 October, 2025
General requirements:
Language requirement: CEFR B2, IELTS 6.0, TOEFL iBT 79, TOEIC (Listening – Reading 730, Speaking – Writing 280) or an equivalent level of English proficiency
Acculative GPA at sending institution (for students only): At least 2.5/4
Fact Sheet
Visit the link to find the fact sheet of the academic year 2025/2026 and application form for your reference:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qhzGAweGBkE8rSq5GoFB4KA_YOD98N-l?usp=sharing
For further details of the exchange program at HCMUT, please visit:
https://hcmut.edu.vn/en/study/exchange/academic
Contact for further information and enquires:
External Affairs Office
Email: inter@hcmut.edu.vn
Telephone:
84 28 38 652 442
